warnings: Steel hip roof (main pyramid, apex at A'''2, plus a lower hipped wing over bay 1-2 rows B-D with its ridge on 1''). Members from the sheet's หมายเหตุ legend: แป เหล็กกล่อง-25x25x1.6 @0.50 (or แป ชุบกัลวาไนท์ ตราช้าง หนา 7 มม. @0.50), จันทัน C-100x50x20x3.2 @1.00, ตะเข้ราง C-100x50x20x3.2, ตะเข้สัน 2C-100x50x20x3.2, and one linetype each for TRUSS T1, T2, T3 (also labelled on the plan). Roofing หลังคามุงกระเบื้องพรีม่า ตราช้าง (not structural, not recorded).

Trusses split at their supports (T1 at A, B, D on grid 2 — per the T1 elevation; T2 at grids 1, 2, 3 on A'''; T3 from A''' to D on 1''). Their bottom chords are the interior อะเส lines of S-03 (flagged truss_bottom_chord there) — a consumer summing steel must not add both.

Eave segments are top chord only: T1 past A to A', T2 past 1 and 3 to 1'/3'', T3 past D to D' (1.00 on this sheet's chains; the T2/T3 elevations draw the chord running past the support). The plan also draws T1's line on past D to D', but the T1 elevation shows no overhang on the D side (its top chord ends near C, under the wing roof) — detail beats plan (op01 precedence 2), so no D-side T1 segment.

Rafters, purlins, hips and the valley carry no mark: element_id null with element_name_assigned (section 0.2). Hip-roof jack rafters are cut by the hips into many different lengths, so the rafter count is left null (spacing @1.00 is printed); purlins are drawn only inside the two cut-away bubbles, so their count is null too.

Hips counted from the drawn long-dash lines: 6 — three main hips from the eave corners A'1', A'3'' and D3'' to the apex, a fourth main hip from the apex down to the wing ridge on 1'' (stopped there by the wing), and two wing hips from the wing ridge end (about 6.52 from A on 1'') to the wing eave corners D'1' and about x 5.00 on D'. Valley: 1 (double line) from the wing ridge on 1'' (about 5.48 from A) down to row D at about x 5.00. Their wing-side ends are not on grid lines, so these carry area refs, not point refs.
The purlin box section is printed as 'เหล็กกล่อง-25x25x1.6' — designation kept in Thai as printed (section 6a: no translation to SHS).
